question_cn: 当对方对你实施透视攻击时，最有效的防御方式是什么？
question_en: What is the most effective way to defend against an X-ray attack?

options.text_cn: 无法防御，透视攻击必然得手
options.text_en: There is no defense; an X-ray attack is always successful

options.text_cn: 把中间棋子移走，让对方失去穿透的通路
options.text_en: Move the intervening piece so the attacker loses its line through the position

options.text_cn: 消除透视线（移开后方目标或加派棋子保护），或反将军化解威胁
options.text_en: Break the X-ray line by moving or reinforcing the target, or meet the threat with a countercheck

options.text_cn: 只需要移动王就能解决所有透视威胁
options.text_en: Moving the king is enough to solve every X-ray threat

explanation_cn: 防御透视攻击的核心是：①移走后方被盯住的目标，离开透视线；②在透视线上加插己方棋子，打断透视；③反将军或发动反攻，让对方无暇兑现透视威胁。将中间棋子移走反而会让透视立即爆发，是错误的应对。
explanation_en: To defend against an X-ray attack, move the deeper target off the line, add a piece to block or reinforce along the line, or use a countercheck or counterattack to interrupt the threat. Moving the intervening piece can instead open the line and make the attack immediate.
